verdict_note: Nothing found that breaks the build or a test the builder already ran at 4c0103f0. The rebase onto origin 35c50d3b is textually clean for this lane: the 8 origin commits touch no native-host or kumihimo-ui file, and their harness-view change (an added export_settings key in state_json) leaves every API the frame reads in place. Two native-host fixes are cheap and change code the bundled run proves, so do them before that run instead of rerunning after. F1: the presence chip is a Button with no action, so a click on it is silently dropped and an invoke answers unknown_author_id. That is the exact class the B6 ruling forbids. F2: at FIT-L1 (logical width 2400 and up, so 2560x1440 at 1 and 3840x2160 at 1) the Browse Dock gets 260 px and studio.dock.state says expanded, but the panel still builds the collapsed icon rail with its Expand button. The state node and the tree then give contradicting answers. F3 is low: dock roots lack the components.json Region role. Of the builder's choices, three are right: the spine scale matrix at 2048x1280, the wheel test at 800x324, and the F5 row search. The presence-chip choice is wrong (F1). The ellipsis cache in Text is keyed and invalidated correctly.

findings.severity: silent drop (B6 ruling: never a silent drop) and a wrong typed answer on invoke
findings.where: crates/kumihimo-ui/src/widgets.rs:429-441 (presence_chip: Node::new(id, Role::Button) with no .actions and no .reason); crates/hsk-studio-native-host/src/gui/chrome.rs:95 (studio.presence.operator); gui/mod.rs:672-679 (release path) and :809-814 (activate falls to Err("unknown_author_id")); design data components.json presence_chip: role Button, keyboard ["Enter opens Follow Actor and Actor Attribution"]
findings.what: The presence chip is an unbuilt control by the design data: a Button whose Enter opens Follow Actor. It is built with no actions and so is not interactive. hit_test returns only interactive nodes (hit.rs:27), so a press on it sets no Interaction press and disabled_at gives None. The release then reaches `pressed_static.filter(..)?` with None and returns None: no outcome, no status line, no receipt. By invoke, activate finds the node but flags.disabled is false, so it answers Err("unknown_author_id") for an id that is plainly in the tree. The test every_control_answers_and_static_ones_say_not_implemented_yet filters on non-empty actions, so it never sees this node.
findings.scenario: The Operator clicks the O chip at the right of the menu bar: nothing happens and the status bar keeps the previous outcome. A model reads the tree, sees Button studio.presence.operator, calls GuiFrame::invoke("studio.presence.operator") and gets unknown_author_id, which says the control does not exist.
findings.fix: Give presence_chip a `reason: Option<&str>` argument and build it with `.actions(CLICK).reason(reason)` (it stays a non-popping indicator; B6 disabled with a reason). Pass REASON at chrome.rs:95 and niy in gallery::contact_sheet. activate then answers frame.static not_implemented_yet by click and by invoke, and the sweep test covers it with no test change. The widget is new in this lane, so no golden moves.

findings.severity: wrong answer: the observability node and the tree contradict each other at two ladder sizes
findings.where: crates/hsk-studio-native-host/src/gui/frame.rs:151-154 (FIT-L1 sets left_state Expanded, left_w 260); gui/mod.rs:1042 (`p[BROWSE].update(.., l.left, .., chrome::browse_rail)` whatever l.left_state is); chrome.rs:221-235 (browse_rail: Toolbar studio.dock.left, 32 px buttons, studio.rail.left.expand); gui/mod.rs dock_state (left 260, left_state expanded)
findings.what: The layout widens the Browse Dock to 260 under FIT-L1 and studio.dock.state reports left_state expanded. The view does not branch on the state. It always builds the collapsed rail (the Expand button and six 32 px icon buttons centred in a 260 px column). The brief (item 6, Browse Dock) asks for one group of the six LEFT tabs with empty states through the same group view. The inspect side does branch (inspect_rail vs inspect_dock, mod.rs:1044-1045), so this is a missed case, not a design choice. No test opens a GuiFrame at FIT-L1: dock_state_equals_fit_table_at_the_matrix_windows uses 2560x1440 at 1.5 and 3840x2160 at 2, and gui_layout checks rects only.
findings.scenario: The window is 2560x1440 at scale 1 (fit_table raster row, FIT-L1), or 3840x2160 at 1 from the lead's ladder. studio.dock.state says {"left":260,"left_state":"expanded"}, while the tree under studio.dock.left offers "Expand Browse Dock" and the pixels show a wide strip of rail buttons. A model trusting either surface is wrong about the other. The designer's AC-LOOK comparison at those sizes would also show a collapsed rail where the ladder says expanded.
findings.fix: In update(), branch on l.left_state as the Inspect Dock does. When it is Expanded, build studio.dock.left as one group: group_id(LEFT[0].id), tabs studio.tab.<panel> for the six LEFT panels, fit_tabs over l.left.w(), and the active body as empty_state_at(studio.panel.<panel>.empty, name, NOT_BUILT). Add a `left_tab` index to GuiFrame and a LEFT arm to the tab loop in activate (frame.tab_select, bump BROWSE and OBSERVE), and add it to the fits key. Add the group to dock_state. Add one GuiFrame test at 2560x1440 scale 1: the tree has studio.group.brushes with six tabs and no studio.rail.left.expand, clipped() is empty, and every interactive node answers. If the lead prefers to defer the expanded view, stop FIT-L1 from changing left_state in this slice instead, so the state matches what is drawn, and record the deviation.

findings.severity: low: semantic-tree role and id differ from components.json (a model querying by role or id gets no match)
findings.where: chrome.rs:223 (studio.dock.left Role::Toolbar), :242 (studio.dock.bottom Role::Toolbar), :286 (studio.dock.right Role::Group), :334 (studio.dock.right Role::Toolbar); chrome.rs:118 (studio.tab-strip); components.json dock_region role Region author_id studio.dock.<region_id>, document_tab_strip role TabList author_id studio.tabstrip
findings.what: Role::Region was added (tree.rs) because components.json gives dock_region the Region role, but no node uses it. The four dock roots are Toolbar or Group. The document tab strip root is studio.tab-strip, while components.json names it studio.tabstrip. The mock has no data-a for either, so components.json is the only source. The brief says ids follow components.json literally until the UiDescriptor generator.
findings.scenario: A model looks for the Region nodes to find the docks (STU-MDL-106 consumers) and finds none. A model invoking or finding studio.tabstrip gets unknown_author_id.
findings.fix: Make each dock root Role::Region, and keep the rail inside it as a Toolbar child where it is an icon rail (components.json icon_rail is Toolbar). Rename studio.tab-strip to studio.tabstrip, or record the deviation for the designer. Update the root list in gui_chrome.rs frame_regions_panels_and_ids. No golden changes.

checked: Full diff 42e9e5a4..4c0103f0 (10 commits, 27 files). 4c0103f0 only widens the storm bound from 4 to 5 panels per frame, which is right: picks touch RAIL, CONTEXT, OBSERVE and STATUS, tab switches touch INSPECT, OBSERVE and STATUS, so a batch touches 5.

Silent-drop sweep: the gui/mod.rs `.ok().flatten()` site is gone. Err now becomes frame.pointer <code> in the status bar and the receipt (mod.rs:680-684). A release on a disabled control answers through press_static only when it is released over the same control (button rule kept). Every frame widget with actions either has .reason(NIY) or is in the table (tool_slot, group tabs, Layers rows and eyes, list). Node::reason sets the value only when it is empty, and every widget that sets a value first (chevrons, +N, the dropdown) puts NIY first, so activate's starts_with(NIY) test holds for all of them. The one exception is the presence chip (F1). The active group tab is still Ok(None), as in the spine.

Hit routing over the 9 painted panels (mod.rs:609-616) against the 11 lists in compose. The proxy chips (x 15..38) lie inside the rail node, and the document list is scissored to layout.canvas inside the centre. Seams draw inside their owner rect, so no pixel is painted by one panel and hit-routed to another above the floor. Below the floor, unclipped band roots can spill; that is accepted.

Fit ladder by hand from frame.rs. 1024x640: right 300 expanded, groups 148/119/227, none collapsed, rail pitch 28 with 14 shown and 5 hidden. 1280x720: groups 172/138/264, 17 shown and 2 hidden. 1920x1080: the mock's rects. 2560x1440 at 1.5: centre 1330.67, groups 244/195/375, physical edges whole. 3840x2160 at 1: FIT-L1, left 260, groups 604/483/927. No negative size: every clamp has min <= max (x_left <= w, x_right <= w, y_ctx <= y_status), so f32::clamp cannot panic. In FIT-H2 with a negative remainder, the top-down clamp gives zero-height groups, never negative ones.

AC-GEOM-01 partition: adjacent regions are built from the same f32 edge values, so the snapped edges coincide. checks::partition reports Outside, Overlap and Uncovered, and its coverage sum is taken only when there is no overlap.

GUI_MIN_LOGICAL = (size::WINDOW_MIN_W, WINDOW_MIN_H) from the tokens. It is applied only to the non-quiet Operator window, clamped to the primary monitor's logical size. below_min uses the same tokens. The cfg(feature="document") gating is consistent with lib.rs (the gui module is document-only).

PaintStats: CpuChrome sums the stats over all lists, frame() stores them, and receipt() writes gui.frame.paint {prims, glyphs, glyph_refusals, missing_resources}. Every icon name the chrome asks for exists in icon_data (tool and ui tables), and IconId(0) is reported as missing rather than given a blank mask.

AccessKit roles: the 9 new Role variants with matching names. Viewer is Canvas, status is Status, search is SearchInput, dropdowns are ComboBox, menu is MenuBar/MenuItem, panel bodies are TabPanel. Region and ScrollBar are added but unused (F3).

Quiet and offscreen: window.rs changes only the min size of the non-quiet window. Pressing a disabled control moves no Interaction focus (pointer_down filters effectively_disabled). No OS focus call was added.

Ellipsis cache (Text.fits): the key is (text, token, weight, max_w bits, middle). Shaping is in logical px and the shape cache has no scale key either, so scale needs no key and clear_masks rightly leaves it alone. A font change means a new Text (new epoch, empty cache). Strings over MAX_LABEL_BYTES are searched, never cached. The cache resets whole at max_lines. search_middle's index arithmetic stays inside head and tail at kmax, and the head and tail never overlap. The frame-level fits memo key covers every input measure_fits reads (extent and scale for the layout, text epoch, file name, device, backend, revision, unsaved, tabs, size text). The edges are constant.

Ids: every frame id passes valid_author_id (kebab, lowercase, at least 2 segments, including studio.toolgroup.smart-select). There are no stable_id collisions within a panel or across panels. author_ids are unique across panels, as asserted by the test. studio.viewer.raster is gone from the asset tree; VIEWER_ID is studio.viewer.canvas, and the README and tests follow.

kumihimo-ui display.rs, paint.rs, geom.rs and tokens.rs are unedited, and tests/paint.rs (goldens) is unedited. The emit changes are inert for existing widgets: seams are empty by default, unfocused_group is false by default, and the ellipsis no-draw case applies only when even the ellipsis does not fit.

The builder's choices. The spine scale matrix at 2048x1280 is right: it keeps logical >= 1024x640 at scales 1 to 2, so the spine asserts stay above the floor, and the scale list is unchanged. The wheel test at 800x324 is right: FIT-H2 keeps the Layers group open with a body of exactly 100, as computed. The F5 row search is right: at 1200x720 and 1.2 the rows start at logical 324, and Red's edge 427.2 snaps down. The search panics if no such row exists, so the test cannot pass vacuously. The presence chip taking no clicks is wrong (F1).
